attribute_heads: retained for matched initialization; not trained or reported
full_reference: historical recipe reference only; not a runtime artifact dependency
learning_rate_schedule: JH2 epoch cosine; constant within each epoch
reference_recipe: Native+attributes benchmark with identical model construction and frozen source split
selection_evidence: test-selected benchmark control; not clean evidence
split: original JH2 seed1 official-train subtrain/validation split; sample IDs and support are recorded in split_reference.json
test_policy: selection dataset official test is read each epoch; the other target is first read after source-native checkpoint and thresholds freeze
threshold_source: not applicable; no supervised C/W readout
